en: The image is a vintage postcard showing a tranquil lake scene surrounded by trees. There are several rowboats docked along the shore, and a few boats with people rowing on the water. On the left side, there appear to be tables and chairs, possibly part of a lakeside cafe or park seating area. The overall tone is monochromatic, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The top right corner has the printed text 'GRAZ — Hilmteich' in red.
